title: Improve UI Readability: Master CSS 'hyphens' for Perfect Justified Text and Web Fonts
tweet: Enhance your #CSS typography! Learn how 'hyphens' improves #UI design & #UserExperience by creating balanced justified text with web fonts. A must for every front-end dev! #WebFonts
tip: Utilize the 'hyphens' CSS property to prevent awkward gaps in justified text or narrow columns. Setting 'hyphens: auto;' combined with a 'lang' attribute on your HTML element significantly improves readability and the visual flow of your WebFonts, contributing to a superior UserExperience in UIDesign.
